ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to distal tips and surface glints, indicating a low global contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark-grey to black contiguous mapping across both lobes; small, high-contrast white/light-grey punctate clusters are localized exclusively at the distal tips of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 45 degrees; the notch depth is approximately 1/8th of the vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary; pixel amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels, with the most significant jagged topography located on the lateral third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory curving from the median notch toward the distal tips, forming a symmetrical recurved profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters detected at the distal tips of both lobes, with a higher density and larger spatial footprint on the left lobe (viewer's perspective) tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear disruptions in pixel intensity visible in the central and right-central fluke regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical protrusions and associated white scarring at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization (e.g., Coronula diadema).
